title: Egg Mayonnaise
description: A classic Continental appetizer featuring perfectly cooked eggs served with silky homemade mayonnaise, finished with capers, herbs, and elegant garnishes for a refined restaurant-style presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Eggs
items: White wine vinegar – 1 tsp (optional, for poaching-style shell cooking)

ingredients.title: For the Mayonnaise
items: White wine vinegar or lemon juice – 1 tbsp
Freshly ground white pepper – to taste
Neutral oil (grapeseed, sunflower, or light olive oil) – 250 ml
Optional: a few drops of truffle oil or lemon zest for sophistication

ingredients.title: For the Garnish
items: Fresh chives or dill – finely chopped
Microgreens or baby lettuce – for plating
Extra virgin olive oil – to drizzle

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Eggs
steps: Bring a large pot of water to a gentle boil.
Lower the eggs in carefully and cook for 8½ minutes for perfectly set yolks (creamy but firm).
Immediately plunge into ice water to stop cooking.
Once cooled, peel carefully and pat dry.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Mayonnaise
steps: In a mixing bowl, whisk together egg yolks, Dijon mustard, and vinegar or lemon juice until smooth.
Slowly drizzle in the oil in a thin stream, whisking constantly to emulsify.
When thick and creamy, season with salt and white pepper.
Optionally, whisk in a few drops of truffle oil or lemon zest for a luxurious finish.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assembly
steps: Arrange them on chilled plates or a light salad base of baby greens.
Spoon or pipe the mayonnaise generously over or beside the eggs.
Sprinkle with capers, cornichons, chives, and cracked pink peppercorns.
Drizzle lightly with extra virgin olive oil.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Presentation
steps: Use white porcelain plates or slate boards.
Place two or three egg halves per serving, slightly overlapping.
Pipe the mayonnaise in elegant dollops or quenelles beside the eggs.
Garnish with microgreens and a fine drizzle of oil for shine.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a classic Continental appetizer.
Pair with toasted sourdough or crusty bread.
Accompany with a crisp green salad for a light meal.

chefTips: Add a splash of vinegar to the boiling water — it helps prevent egg whites from seeping if any shells crack.
The mayonnaise should coat a spoon and hold a soft peak — silky, not greasy.
For a luxurious finish, whisk in a few drops of truffle oil or lemon zest.
Try variations such as smoked salmon, caviar, or herbed mayonnaise for an elevated presentation.
